attempts.summary: Deployed a simple inventory web application on node1 (CentOS Stream 10), served by httpd on TCP port 8181, while keeping SELinux in enforcing mode. Fixed the SELinux port labeling gap (8181 was not in http_port_t) with `semanage port -a -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181`, opened the firewalld port, verified the app serves HTTP 200, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed the boot ID changed and all state (SELinux enforcing, httpd active, port context, firewall rule, app content) recovered cleanly.
